fullDescription: A high-end futuristic tech-blue data management dashboard style. Features a deep dark theme with cyan and cobalt accents, glassmorphism panels, and glowing micro-interactions. Optimized for enterprise SaaS, smart city monitoring, cybersecurity command centers, and fintech analytics platforms. Utilizes a structured layout with a collapsible advanced filter system and high-density data tables.
prompt:
## Resumo
An advanced dark-themed tech dashboard for data query and visualization. It uses a color palette of deep blacks, navy blues, and electric cyan highlights. The interface employs glassmorphism, glowing borders, and subtle pulse animations to convey a 'living system' feel. Layout includes a header with system status, a comprehensive search and filter suite, and a detailed data table with custom progress indicators.

## Estilo Visual
Set the overall theme to dark-mode tech using a base background of #05080c. Main panels should have a glass effect: background linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(15, 20, 25, 0.95) 0%, rgba(15, 20, 25, 0.98) 100%), backdrop-filter: blur(10px), and a border of 1px solid #1a2332. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all UI text and 'Monospace' for data IDs and percentages. Accent colors: Primary Cyan (#00D4FF), Secondary Blue (#4A90E2), Success (#10B981), Warning (#F59E0B), Danger (#EF4444). Implement a 'tech-border' effect using 1px gradient lines (90deg, transparent, rgba(0, 212, 255, 0.5), transparent). Interactive elements should have glow effects (box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0,212,255,0.2)) and smooth 200ms transitions.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header Section
Create a top header (height ~80px) with px-8 padding. Left side: logo icon in a gradient box (#1a2332 to #0A0E17) with a cyan glow, followed by an h1 title (text-white, font-bold) and a status subtext featuring a pulsing emerald dot. Right side: three-button action group (Settings, Export, New Entry). Buttons use varied styles: outlined, soft-glow blue, and full gradient (#4A90E2 to #00D4FF).

### Search and Filter Toolbar
Design a two-row toolbar. Row 1: A 400px wide search input with a left-aligned magnifying glass and a right-aligned keyboard shortcut hint (kbd styling). Row 2: A collapsible advanced filter grid (4 columns) with a left-side vertical accent line (gradient #4A90E2 to transparent). Filter inputs use #0A0E17 backgrounds, #1a2332 borders, and custom chevron-down icons.

### Data Table Area
Implement a high-density table with a sticky header. Header cells: #0F1419 background, text-slate-400, uppercase, with sorting arrows. Table rows: #1a2332/50 divider, hover state background change to #1a2332/40. Each row must feature a hidden 1px cyan left-border glow that appears on hover. Columns should support: ID (monospace), Name (bold) + Sub-description (small text), Type Badge, Status Badge with pulse dot, Avatar + Name, Date Range, and Gradient Progress Bars.

### Pagination Footer
Stick a footer at the bottom with px-8 py-4. Left: total count and 'results per page' dropdown using #05080c background. Right: numeric pagination buttons. The active page button should have a gradient background (#4A90E2 to #00D4FF) and a cyan shadow (0 0 10px rgba(0,212,255,0.3)).

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Status Badge with Pulse — Circular indicator with a living animation
Create a pill-shaped badge with 10% opacity background of the status color (e.g., cyan, emerald, red). Inside, place a 6px solid dot with an 'animate-pulse' animation and text-xs font-medium. Border should be 1px solid at 20% opacity of the status color.

### Tech-Gradient Progress Bar — Progress bar with internal light sweep
Container: 6px height, #0A0E17 background, 1px border #1a2332. Progress fill: linear-gradient(to right, #4A90E2, #00D4FF). Add a white-glare overlay (width: 16px, blur: 2px, opacity: 0.3) that sits at the leading edge of the progress fill to simulate a light sweep.

### Corner Accents — Futuristic framing elements
Apply absolute-positioned 16px x 16px L-shaped corner brackets to the main dashboard container. Style: 2px border-top and border-left (for top-left corner), color #00D4FF, opacity 0.5, with rounded corners matching the container's 2xl radius.
